_about: Written from the reasoning the two tracks recorded when they placed these bets on Sat Sep 19 2026. Every claim here is what the track cited at the time; nothing has been added after the fact. No homework section for these games — the run placed the bets but did not produce one.

tracks.intro: Two of Ahmed's rows are picked by Claude, each by a fixed method, and placed through the same form as everyone else. Research buys whatever the crowd most believes, at the best Kalshi price for that side. Statistics bets only where a price is wrong by more than the fee, and sits out otherwise — this weekend it sat out five of six games.

research.verdict: The most lopsided crowd on the board, and the dearest ticket — so it got the fewest contracts. The crowd is probably right here; you just pay for it.

evidence.text: 98% of moneyline tickets and 94% of moneyline money are on Kansas City; 76% of bets and 77% of handle on KC −6.5 at BetMGM.
Expert count 8–2 Kansas City straight up.
Models: ESPN Matchup Predictor 75%, nfelo 73%, Dimers 70%, Opta 67.4%.

Kansas City ran for 220 yards at 5.9 a carry in Week 1 against Denver's No. 2 run defence, while Indianapolis gave up 202 rushing yards and four rushing touchdowns to Baltimore and carries the NFL's longest active losing streak at eight.
Smallest contract count of the six, because 73¢ is the dearest ticket on the board.

research.method: Bets whatever the crowd most believes will win, at the best Kalshi price for that side.

statistics.method: Bets only where the price is wrong by more than the fee.
statistics.pick: No bet — sat this one out
statistics.verdict: No edge. At 73¢ Kalshi is already at or past where the models put Kansas City, so there is nothing to buy.
